neet_phy_u09_t05_1.working: A monatomic gas has 3 translational degrees of freedom. Each contributes R/2 per mole, so Cv = 3R/2.

neet_phy_u09_t05_4.working: Monatomic Cv = 3R/2 (III). Rigid diatomic Cp = 7R/2 (IV). Dulong-Petit gives 3R (II). Monatomic Cp = 5R/2 (I).

neet_phy_u09_t05_5.working: A is true: Cv = 3R, Cp = 4R, so γ = 4/3. B is false: for a mixture, Cv and Cp are mole-weighted, not γ. C is true: each vibrational mode gives kT (kinetic plus potential). D is true: γ ranges above 1 up to 5/3. E is false: water's molar heat capacity is about 9R.
